title: 基于大语言模型与强化学习的自主施工与进度更新
summary: 该研究提出一种基于大语言模型与强化学习的自主施工方法：用增强型软演员-评论家算法为移动起重机规划施工动作，结合机器人运动学与控制算法保证可执行性；定制嵌入模型按用户兴趣提取施工环境信息；并用ChatGPT 5更新施工进度、向控制系统提供安全信息并生成进度报告，通过挡土墙施工实验验证可行性。
summary_en: This study proposes an autonomous construction method combining LLM and reinforcement learning: an enhanced soft actor-critic algorithm plans mobile crane actions for construction tasks, with robot kinematics and control ensuring executability; a customized embedding model extracts environment information by user interest; ChatGPT 5 updates progress, supplies safety information to the control system, and generates progress reports, validated by full-scale retaining wall experiments.
